podcast.body: Released on November 7, 1995, this album was created by U2 under the pseudonym Passengers, with Brian Eno as producer. Approximately half of the album consisted of instrumental tracks, which U2 described as "great time music." Despite its unique nature, it achieved moderate chart success, reaching number 15 on the Canadian album charts, number 12 in the UK, but only number 76 in the US. "their album was released on November 7, 1995. About half of it was instrumental."
